g.text: 16 273 RB, seventeen SRS hops and CSI age
Code baseline 3efa44c; formulas C01-C38 / L01-L17 / Z01-Z03 / R01-R04
Each hop measures 16 RB; hop 17 measures 17 RB. Data weighting uses transmitted RB / 273 (C07).
30% traffic load and 30-50% PRB utilization are separate acceptance quantities.
C07-C10; chasi_config.m and chasi_generate_scene.m. Bars show group metadata and timing, not sampled SRS waveforms or calibrated CSI ages.
